Lahore Tuition Centre Collapse Claims 14 Children's Lives

A private tuition centre in Lahore, Pakistan collapsed, killing at least 14 children aged seven to thirteen and injuring 20 others. The incident occurred in an under-construction building, prompting concerns about safety standards.
